smell_validity.evidence: Injected methods live on the analysis types yet never read their fields, and callers pass the struct's own state as arguments (self.recursive_add_rows(..., &self.tree, ...), starting_positions(items, &paths.opts)), so misplaced ownership—measurement and selection rules belong to the items graph and entry types—is clear. One coherent story across four analyses and three formats; a defensible 'analyses own emit logic' reading keeps it short of reference quality.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The injected methods force duplicate context sources (opts and tree held by the struct yet re-supplied as parameters), leave dead opts parameters, and keep retained-size guard knowledge scattered in the analyze crate, so future format or option changes must keep several copies in agreement. Real, added error-proneness; but bounded to the report stage, not architecture-level.

development_plausibility.evidence: The move reads as a genuinely useful cleanup pass—deduplicating shared size/share computation and grouping per-item helpers with the analyses they serve—in the file's own doc-comment and feature-gate style. The weakness (methods keeping every parameter, unused receivers, dead opts arguments) is exactly the mechanical drift real refactors leave. Only the four-file simultaneity and rewritten closure-style paths arms look task-shaped.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Names all affected analyses and formats with a pattern the code confirms (receivers contribute nothing), the finished state (derivation moves to the items graph and entry types; orchestration stays), and exclusions that block gutting the analyses. The retained-size clause bars the always-compute shortcut byte-for-byte expectations cannot catch, and the unused-receiver note blocks cosmetic partial fixes—a model refactoring contract.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Counted purposes each demand a different code-supported decision: item measurement (encoding the retained-computed guard as Option), starting-position selection (regex arm needs '?' error propagation, exact names Option filtering, two distinct largest-first orderings), entry JSON filling (Result-returning object mutation) versus CSV records (value return, module-level feature-gated type, joined list), and per-format consumption (text fallback). No single rule repeats unchanged.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the four analyses and three formats, so most sites are listed; completing the scope still requires walking each emitter's helper chains (walker to builder) and judging borderline pre-existing free functions such as the paths entry constructor and remaining text closures. All within one crate's local call chains; no cross-component dataflow is needed to classify a site.

repair_coordination.evidence: One shared rule must hold at several sites: the moved measurement's Option/guard semantics must match the text path's fallback and the JSON/CSV conditional retained-field inclusion simultaneously, and selection ordering must stay consistent with traversal. Change only the derivation or only one consumer and report bytes diverge; expectation files catch it only per format.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: A single relocate-to-data-owner rule cleanly repairs roughly two-fifths: the top measurement and both monos entry fillers move mechanically, and the paths queries largely do; the dominators builders entangled with Table, json::Object, and the CSV writer must be split into derivation versus presentation, and the three walkers need receiver/parameter rework—under 60% falls to one rule.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Two silent paths exist: computing retained sizes eagerly satisfies every byte-for-byte expectation while breaking the computed-on-request discipline (the prompt's preservation clause proves tests cannot catch it), and dropping the regex arm's error propagation stays silent because expectation files cover only valid patterns. The mandated default-feature build/test run exercises neither.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
